name: Health Insurance Policy Retail

room_rent.quote: Room, Board & Nursing expenses as charged by the Hospital/Nursing Home Excluding registration and service Expenses are covered up to 1% of the Sum Insured per day and if admitted into Intensive Care Unit up to 2% of the Sum Insured per day
room_rent.note: Maximum up to 25% of the Sum Insured per illness/injury for Room, Board & Nursing Expenses including ICU.

proportionate.quote: In case the insured opts for a room with rent higher than the entitled category as under point no. 1, the charges payable under point 1, 2 and 3 shall be limited to the charges applicable to the entitled category.

copay.quote: Co-pay: For all admissible claims in non-network hospitals, Insured shall bear 10% of the admissible claim in addition to the excess as per terms of insurance

waiting_initial.quote: Medical Expenses incurred for any disease / illness or diagnosable within 30 days, of the commencement (Commencement Date of first Health Insurance Policy with us) of the Policy Period except those incurred as a result of Accidental Bodily Injury.

waiting_ped.quote: Benefits will not be available for Any condition, whether diagnosed or not, ailment or injury or related condition(s) for which Insured has been diagnosed, received medical treatment, had signs and / or symptoms, prior to inception of Insured’s first Policy, until 48 consecutive months have elapsed

specific_waits.quote:
Exclusions applicable to first year of cover from commencement of the Policy, from the following Diseases / Illness and its related complications:
Any types of gastric or duodenal ulcers,
Tonsillectomy, Adenoidectomy, Mastoidectomy, Tympanoplasty
Surgery on all internal or external tumor /cysts/nodules/polyps of any kind including breast lumps
All types of Hernia and Hydrocele
Anal Fissures, Fistula and Piles
specific_waits.label: Hernia and Hydrocele

specific_waits.quote:
Any types of gastric or duodenal ulcers,
Tonsillectomy, Adenoidectomy, Mastoidectomy, Tympanoplasty
Surgery on all internal or external tumor /cysts/nodules/polyps of any kind including breast lumps
All types of Hernia and Hydrocele
Anal Fissures, Fistula and Piles
specific_waits.label: Gastric or duodenal ulcers, ENT surgeries, tumors/cysts/nodules/polyps, fissures/fistula/piles

specific_waits.quote:
Exclusions applicable to first two years of cover from commencement of the Policy, from the following Diseases / Illness and its related complications:
Cataract
specific_waits.label: Cataract

specific_waits.quote:
Benign Prostatic Hypertrophy
Hysterectomy/ myomectomy for menorrhagia or fibromyoma or prolapse of uterus
Hypertension, Heart Disease and related complications
Diabetes and related complications
specific_waits.label: BPH, Hysterectomy/Myomectomy, Hypertension, Heart Disease, Diabetes

specific_waits.quote:
Non infective Arthritis, Treatment of Spondylosis / Spondylitis, Gout & Rheumatism
Surgery of Genitourinary tract
Calculus Diseases of any etiology
Sinusitis and related disorders
Surgery for prolapsed intervertebral disc unless arising from accident
Surgery of varicose veins and varicose ulcers
Chronic Renal failure including dialysis
specific_waits.label: Arthritis, Spondylosis, Calculus, Sinusitis, PIVD, Varicose Veins, CRF

specific_waits.quote: Medical Expenses incurred during or in connection with joint replacement surgery due to Degenerative condition, Age related osteoarthritis and Osteoporosis unless such joint replacement surgery is necessitated by accidental Bodily Injury.
specific_waits.label: Joint Replacement Surgery

sublimits.quote: Cataract Treatment: Our obligation to make payment in respect of any claim for treatment of Cataract including surgery thereof under the policy is limited to 15 % of the Sum Insured subject to a maximum of INR 25000 per eye
sublimits.label: Cataract Treatment

exclusions.quote: Epidemics recognized by WHO or/and Indian government. Government screening programs, etc are not covered by this policy.
exclusions.text: Epidemics recognized by WHO or/and Indian government. Government screening programs, etc are not covered by this policy.

exclusions.quote: War, invasion, acts of foreign enemies, hostilities (whether war be declared or not), civil war, commotion, unrest, rebellion, revolution, insurrection, military or usurped power or confiscation or nationalisation
exclusions.text: War, invasion, acts of foreign enemies, hostilities, civil war, commotion, unrest, rebellion, revolution, insurrection, military or usurped power.

exclusions.quote: Injury or Disease directly or indirectly caused by or contributed to by nuclear weapons/materials.
exclusions.text: Injury or Disease directly or indirectly caused by or contributed to by nuclear weapons/materials.

exclusions.quote: Circumcision unless necessary for treatment of a disease, illness or injury not excluded hereunder, or, as may be necessitated due to an accident
exclusions.text: Circumcision unless necessary for treatment of a disease, illness or injury, or necessitated due to an accident.

exclusions.quote: Cosmetic or aesthetic treatments of any description, treatment or surgery for change of life/gender, Lasik treatment for refractive error. Any form of plastic surgery (unless necessary for the treatment of Illness or accidental Bodily Injury).
exclusions.text: Cosmetic or aesthetic treatments, gender change, Lasik treatment, plastic surgery (unless necessary for illness/injury).

exclusions.quote: The cost of spectacles, contact lenses, hearing aids, crutches, wheelchairs, artificial limbs, dentures, artificial teeth and all other external appliances. Prosthesis and/or devices.
exclusions.text: Cost of spectacles, contact lenses, hearing aids, crutches, wheelchairs, artificial limbs, dentures, artificial teeth and external appliances.

exclusions.quote: Dental treatment or surgery of any kind unless required as a result of Accidental Bodily Injury to natural teeth requiring hospitalization treatment.
exclusions.text: Dental treatment or surgery of any kind unless required as a result of Accidental Bodily Injury to natural teeth requiring hospitalization.

exclusions.quote: Convalescence, general debility, “Run-down” condition, rest cure, Congenital Internal and /or external illness/disease/defect.
exclusions.text: Convalescence, general debility, rest cure, Congenital Internal and /or external illness/disease/defect.

exclusions.quote: Intentional self-injury (including but not limited to the use or misuse of any intoxicating drugs or alcohol) and any violation of law or participation in an event/activity that is against law with a criminal intent.
exclusions.text: Intentional self-injury, drug/alcohol misuse, violation of law.

exclusions.quote: Any complications arising out of or ailments requiring treatment due to use or abuse of any substance, drug or alcohol and treatment for de-addiction.
exclusions.text: Complications or treatment due to substance, drug or alcohol abuse and de-addiction.

exclusions.quote: Any condition directly or indirectly caused by or associated with Human Immunodeficiency Virus or Variant/mutant viruses and or any syndrome or condition of a similar kind commonly referred to as AIDS.
Venereal disease or any sexually transmitted disease or sickness.
exclusions.text: Venereal disease or sexually transmitted disease.

exclusions.quote: Treatment arising from or traceable to pregnancy childbirth, miscarriage, abortion or complications of any of this, including caesarian section. However, this exclusion will not apply to abdominal operation for extra uterine pregnancy
exclusions.text: Pregnancy, childbirth, miscarriage, abortion or caesarean section, except ectopic pregnancy.

exclusions.quote: Any fertility, sub fertility or assisted conception operation or sterilization procedure and related treatment.
exclusions.text: Fertility, sub fertility, assisted conception operation or sterilization procedure.

exclusions.quote: Treatment for any mental illness or psychiatric or psychological ailment / condition.
exclusions.text: Mental illness or psychiatric or psychological ailment / condition.

exclusions.quote: Treatment for obesity, weight reduction or weight management.
exclusions.text: Treatment for obesity, weight reduction or weight management.

unmodeled_terms: Admissible claims under Room, Board & Nursing Expenses including ICU restricted to maximum 25% of Sum Insured per illness/injury.
Medical Practitioner/Surgeon/Consultant Fees restricted to maximum 40% of Sum Insured per illness/injury.
OT, Anesthesia, Blood, Oxygen, Medicines, Consumables, Diagnostics, Implants restricted to maximum 40% of Sum Insured per illness/injury.
Zonal co-payment/differential payout depending on Benefit Plan location vs treatment location (e.g. Plan B paying 80% in Location A, Plan C paying 70% in Location A and 80% in Location B).
computable_note: Contains terms the estimator cannot compute exactly: Admissible claims under Room, Board & Nursing Expenses including ICU restricted to maximum 25% of Sum Insured per illness/injury.; Medical Practitioner/Surgeon/Consultant Fees restricted to maximum 40% of Sum Insured per illness/injury.; OT, Anesthesia, Blood, Oxygen, Medicines, Consumables, Diagnostics, Implants restricted to maximum 40% of Sum Insured per illness/injury.
